value: flowers open once, in the early evening at 17h00, and close early the next morning from 4h30 to 6h00
method: direct observation of daily flower opening and closing in a cultivated population (20 flowers of each flower colour); anther opening observed separately
conditions: Herb Garden of the State University of Maringa, Parana, Brazil, November 1998 to March 1999; mean temperature recorded at dusk given as 34.4 to 20.2 C in Methods and 30.4 to 20.2 C in the Discussion (the two disagree); the Portuguese abstract says the flowers opened 'no inicio da tarde, as 17 h' (early afternoon) while the English Results say early evening, both at 17h00; anther dehiscence ran from about 19h30 to 20h30 (same Results paragraph); the paper reports no scent measurement (the Discussion only says the flowers have crepuscular anthesis and strong sweet odours); cultivated plants, flower colours pooled

source.authors: Leal AA, Terada Y, Machado MFPS
source.title: Floral biology of a population of Mirabilis jalapa L. (Nyctaginaceae) from Southern Brazil

where: Results, first paragraph on flowering (PDF download from the journal page); sentence returned in two consecutive segments, split after 'at 17h00,', on two fetches
quote: The flowers of M. jalapa opened for one night in the early evening, at 17h00, and closed early the next morning from 4h30 to 6h00.
note: Authors as the journal page prints them: Ausileide Alves Leal, Yoko Terada, Maria de Fatima Pires da Silva Machado; journal page states the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence; PDF header reads 'Acta Scientiarum Maringa, v. 23, n. 2, p. 587-591, 2001'. The journal page prints DOI 10.4025/actascibiolsci.v23i0.2731 but a Crossref filter query returned no record for it, so no DOI is filed. Accepted name: POWO powo.science.kew.org/taxon/162591-2 opened, 'This species is accepted' (Mirabilis jalapa L.); WFO list.worldfloraonline.org/wfo-0000382148 opened, Mirabilis jalapa accepted, own id wfo-0000448428, December 2023 snapshot. Flower-opening diel record (plant diel = flower opening and scent timing). Full text read. Main already holds a Mirabilis jalapa diel line from a different paper (sweep-18 line 7, Effmert et al. 2005: flowers open about 16:00); this line is a different population, about an hour later and in the same direction. The paper reports no difference by colour form, day or month and has no scent-timing data. The four colour forms are unnamed forms of one population. Issue 2 is from the PDF header.
